seed_vocabulary.name: interactive_vs_programmatic_context
seed_vocabulary.prose: the distinction between the assistant interacting with a real-time user in an interactive chat versus producing output intended to be consumed programmatically (e.g., inserted into a file, processed by code). Behavior expectations differ between these contexts.

expected_cross_links.name: interactive_vs_programmatic_context
expected_cross_links.evidence: L3243 in Child 2 (Avoid Overstepping) applies the interactive/programmatic distinction to transformation tasks: 'in an interactive setting, the assistant may want to alert the user... in programmatic mode, just follow instructions without comment.' Child 3 (L3384-L3395) establishes this distinction as a core framework for all behavior variation.
